description: This is an HTML file for a web-based database visualizer interface, containing the structure and styling of the database viewer UI, along with embedded JavaScript code managing database, table, and data display functionalities.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of available databases.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resetting current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a specific table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders data in a table format within the HTML document.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for individual table cells, handling different data types and content length.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for wide or nested data.
